name: Of Stupidity and Idiotic
source:
A stupid visual novel made for "The worst VN/KN ever created" contest.

The game has:
- 6 endings
- 2 maps for you to explore 
- roughly around 1K5
- BG, art done by me
- A little gift at the end of the game if you got all the ending /shot

Play as a beautiful young girl who tried to get away from the evil man that planned to sell her overboard!

[From [url=http://michiyo6918.deviantart.com/art/Visual-Novel-Of-Stupidity-and-Idiotic-314140355]DeviantArt[/url]]
